settings.hero_description: I’m a video editor and visual storyteller. I shape raw footage into sharp Reels and Shorts, polished brand edits, long-form stories, and wedding films.
settings.about_text: I’m D Kushwanth, a video editor and visual storyteller. I shape raw footage into considered edits for creators, brands, and people celebrating meaningful moments. From a quick, energetic Reel to a longer story, I focus on pacing, detail, and a clear point of view—so every cut feels intentional.
